### Collaboration and Communication Services

**BIOMES (Bern Intestinal Organisms and Microbial Ecosystems Society)** supports its members and contributors in achieving the association’s mission. Below, you will find information on our supported communication and collaboration platforms.

### Microsoft Accounts

For external communications, association projects, and collaborations, BIOMES members may use Microsoft accounts.

-   **BIOMES email**: Your official BIOMES email follows this format: firstname.lastname\@biomes-research.org 1. Used for login and as BIOMES uses Microsoft Outlook as primary email service all emails to firstname.lastname\@biomes-research.org will be received in your Microsoft Outlook mailbox.

-   **Accessing Microsoft services**:
    1.  Visit [Microsoft 365 Login](https://portal.office.com)
    2.  Sign in using your official BIOMES email
    3.  Access Outlook, OneDrive, and Teams

-   **External partner access**:
    -   Partners can be invited as guests to OneDrive/Teams
    -   Must use their own pre-existing Microsoft account
    -   Cannot receive BIOMES Microsoft licenses/accounts

### Google Workspace

Members have the option to use **Google Workspace** tools such as Google Drive, Docs, and Meet.

-   **BIOMES email**: firstname.lastname\@biomes-research.org
    -   Used for login but **not** for Gmail services. Please note that as BIOMES uses Microsoft Outlook as primary email service all emails to firstname.lastname\@biomes-research.org will be received in your Microsoft Outlook mailbox.

-   **Google Workspace alias**: firstname.lastname\@workspace.biomes-research.org
    -   Required for Gmail services
    -   Can be used for signing in

-   **Accessing Google Workspace**:
    1.  Visit [Google Account Login](https://accounts.google.com)
    2.  Sign in with your assigned BIOMES Google email and password
    3.  Use Google Drive, and other tools for internal collaboration

-   **External partner access**:
    -   Can receive full Google Workspace accounts
    -   Email format: firstname.lastname\@external-workspace.biomes-research.org
    -   Contact BIOMES IT team (it\@biomes-research.org) for access requests including a brief justification

### GitHub Organizational Resources

BIOMES maintains an official GitHub organization account for research-related software development and repository management.

-   **GitHub Organization**: [github.com/biomes-research](https://github.com/biomes-research)
-   **Request Access**: If you need access to repositories, contact an administrator or request membership via GitHub.\
-   **Collaboration**: Use GitHub Issues and Discussions to communicate within projects.

### Need Assistance?

For any issues related to Microsoft accounts, Google Workspace, or GitHub access, please reach out to the BIOMES IT team ([it\@biomes-research.org](mailto:it@biomes-research.org)).
